verdicts.reason: A keeps the sun mark and SOLSTICE wordmark on the left and puts the headline over the CTA on the right, so the banner reads left to right. Its flaws: the logo sits tight against the top edge, the CTA is very small, both are jammed against the right edge, and there is a dead gap in the middle. B drops the logo entirely, leaving only a stray dot at the far left, so the brand is gone. Its CTA also wraps awkwardly onto two tiny lines ('Shop the / Summer Line') crammed against the right edge, which weakens the call to action.
